title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘man-made’
part_context: Strongly condemns the obstruction of humanitarian aid to Gaza by the Israeli Government, which has caused a <del>man-made</del> famine in northern Gaza; is particularly alarmed by the report issued by the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC), backed by the Food and Agriculture Organization, the World Food Programme and UNICEF, issuing a critical alert on famine;
